rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a submerged or barely visible reef of rock, sand, or coral.

example.english: There’s a reef in these waters, so be careful when going out to sea.
example.traditional: 呢片海有暗礁，出海要小心。
example.jyutping: ni1 pin3 hoi2 jau5 am3 ziu1 ceot1 hoi2 jiu3 siu2 sam1

rows.note: Use this when the reef is specifically made of coral.

example.english: There are lots of fish in this coral reef.
example.traditional: 呢個珊瑚礁入面有好多魚。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 saan1 wu4 ziu1 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 jyu4
